4.  **Generate Depth Profile:** Compile the sequence $\{d_0^{(1)}, \dots, d_0^{(N)}\}$ to form the time-sequence of echoes for the current beam direction [S1].

The claim states that the sequence {d_0^(1), ..., d_0^(N)} is compiled to form the time-sequence of echoes for the current beam direction. The provided text from Source [S1] explicitly states: 'For each beam direction, we progressively solve wave systems at increasing voxel depths k = 1, . . . , N, measuring the returning echo amplitude d (k) 0 at the transducer location at each step. This generates a complete depth profile {d (1) 0 , . . . , d(N) 0 } representing the time-sequence of echoes received by the transducer.' The notation in the claim (d_0^(k)) matches the notation in the text (d (k) 0), and the description of forming the depth profile as the time-sequence of echoes is directly supported by the text.
